title: Construct a finite functor from finite-list lifts
statement: Let $J$ be small and filtered, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $O$ its chosen object-set colimit with a category structure and functors $V_j:F(j)\to O$. Assume finite lists lift with all endpoint, composition and identity relations, exactly as in [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-category-finite-lift]. For every small finite category $D$ and functor $d:D\to O$, there exist $j$ and $d_j:D\to F(j)$ with $d_j\circ V_j=d$ (Lean's left-to-right composition).

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), first paragraph: 'The formula C = colim C_i means that Ob(C) = colim Ob(C_i) and Arrows(C) = colim Arrows(C_i). Then source, target, and composition are inherited ... Remark that given any finite diagram in C there exists an i such that this diagram is the image of a diagram in C_i' (stated without proof); filtered colimits of sets: categories.tex Section Tag 04AX

proof.text: Enumerate all objects of D and the dependent sum of its morphisms using Fintype.equivFin. Apply the finite-list lifting hypothesis (the conclusion of lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-category-finite-lift), not that theorem itself. Transport the lifted arrows to the lifted object endpoints. Arrow.mk_injective and the identity and composition clauses establish the functor laws; arrow_comp_congr handles endpoint equality proofs. Arrow.functor_ext and the arrow-image clause prove dj ⋙ V j = d. This proof has no dependence on the open finite-lift theorem: its finite-lift assertion is an explicit hypothesis.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_category_finite_functor_lift (J : Type z) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{z, z}) : let O := colimit (F ⋙ Cat.objects) ∀ (_s : Category.{z} O) (V : ∀ j : J, F.obj j ⥤ O), (∀ (n m : ℕ) (X : Fin n → O) (A : Fin m → Arrow O), ∃ (j : J) (Xj : Fin n → F.obj j) (Aj : Fin m → Arrow (F.obj j)), (∀ q, (V j).obj (Xj q) = X q) ∧ (∀ p, (V j).mapArrow.obj (Aj p) = A p) ∧ (∀ p q, (A p).left = X q → (Aj p).left = Xj q) ∧ (∀ p q, (A p).right = X q → (Aj p).right = Xj q) ∧ (∀ p q r (h : (A p).right = (A q).left), Arrow.mk ((A p).hom ≫ eqToHom h ≫ (A q).hom) = A r → ∃ hj : (Aj p).right = (Aj q).left, Arrow.mk ((Aj p).hom ≫ eqToHom hj ≫ (Aj q).hom) = Aj r) ∧ (∀ p q, A p = Arrow.mk (𝟙 (X q)) → Aj p = Arrow.mk (𝟙 (Xj q)))) → (∀ (D : Type z) [SmallCategory D] [FinCategory D] (d : D ⥤ O), ∃ (j : J) (dj : D ⥤ F.obj j), dj ⋙ V j = d)
